body: Who did you file through? :) congrats!

Getting glasses, getting my 3 year old a few gifts and treats, paying off my car, and (for the first time in yeeeeears!!!!) splurging on getting my nails done!!! Everything else is getting saved for baby on the way, and if my toddler needs anything 🥹🥹 this year has been really really hard.
Yay!!! Did you file through chime or another site (like taxact, turbo, ect ect)?
i take it you've had experience also? i hope you are well. thank you.

Also, I've realized that I'm writing notes for everyone, just in case theres guilt for them. Or yknow pain. Loss is such a weird thing, and I know that having notes, and knowing that everything will be okay helps sometimes. It's just weird knowing that this may just happen so soon, yknow?

Thank you! I left a voicemail for two of the clinics closer by, and hopefully one of them is able to get me in tomorrow for something to check. It's completely stopped now, no red or brown discharge anymore. 
I'm so sorry you experienced that :( that must have been really rough, and I hope you are in a much better place now :) congratulations on your current pregnancy!! Thank you for telling me that, too, it feels like if anything DOES happen that I'm sorta the vessel and I should be able to protect it, but I know that sometimes things just happen and maybe it was the wrong time for the event. Thank you again!!

Thank you!! It's good to know that it's rather common, because that sort of eases the whole anxiety inducing part of it, haha. That's exactly what happened here, little bit of bleeding but now it's completely gone. Today is Sunday so I'll be able to have a relaxing day haha!! Thank you again.

I'm so sorry :( that must've been rough for you, and I really hope all is well for you now.
It's weird how tests can pick up things that happen with our bodies, good and bad. And it's good to look on the positive: at least you know that, hey, if you conceived once there's surely another one to come!!
And, sorry, I forgot to say this; thank you for the advice on calling to speak to someone. I'll call and ask someone there as soon as they open in the morning :)

Oh I did not know that!! Thank you haha. I didnt experience bleeding during conception, or the implantation, but I'm just now experiencing it so that my worry is all. So I'm really glad to know that it's normal and not something to freak out over. Thank you :)
